heading: How should I optimize a JPEG camera export?
introduction: Use this page to re-encode a JPEG photograph for its final display or sharing size. JPEG and JPG are the same format; this page uses the same image engine as the JPG tool.

sections.heading: Work from the largest useful source
sections.body: Start from your camera or editor export rather than repeatedly recompressing a previous download. Select a preset, process the image and compare the output at its intended viewing size.

sections.heading: Changing an extension does not compress a photograph
sections.body: Renaming .jpeg to .jpg leaves the encoded image data unchanged. This tool creates a new encoded image, which can change both file size and detail. Higher output quality cannot restore detail lost in an earlier export.

sections.heading: Check the finished image
sections.body: Review gradients, fine textures and text, along with the output dimensions and orientation. Keep an original for printing or further editing. If the download is larger without a useful benefit, keep the original version.

seoDescription: Optimize JPEG photographs with browser-based quality and dimension controls. JPG and JPEG use the same format; review each re-encoded result.
